name: GT-kitaev-projective-tensor-norm

refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex:1228-1232 VERBATIM: "The proof involves the concept of a diagonal. Let us give its general definition for completeness, and then specialize to the finite-dimensional case. For arbitrary Banach algebras $\calA$ and $\calB$, the projective tensor product $\calA\hotimes\calB$ is also a Banach algebra. In more detail, $\calA\hotimes\calB$ is the completion of $\calA\otimes\calB$ endowed with the projective tensor norm,
\begin{equation}
\|C\|=\inf\biggl\{\sum_{j}\|A_j\|\ts\|B_j\|:\,
\sum_{j}A_j\otimes B_j=C\biggr\}\qquad (A_j\in\calA,\,\: B_j\in\calB),
\end{equation}"
